endpoints.label: Cost per run
endpoints.note: Gamma log-link: ratio of ARITHMETIC mean cost. Model-factor effect is partly fixed by the price schedule.

endpoints.label: Wall-clock time
endpoints.note: Seconds/60. A pure rescaling: every ratio and every p-value is identical to the analysis in seconds.

endpoints.label: Engineered features selected
endpoints.note: Nested inside both of the two counts above.

endpoints.label: Engineered share of selected features
endpoints.note: ALGEBRAICALLY n_engineered_features_selected / n_features_after_fs -- not an independent endpoint.

endpoints.label: Total tokens
endpoints.note: Added because it is what separates a PRICE effect from a BEHAVIOR effect in the cost result. PLAN.md is explicit that token counts are NOT structural: resource use is an observed outcome.

endpoints.label: Agent turns
endpoints.note: Added as a price-free measure of how much work the workflow actually did.

endpoints.label: Inner-CV score (Optuna best)
endpoints.note: Added to test the optimism gap: does the score the modeling agent optimizes track held-out PR-AUC?
